answer: Random peer audit stops sybil attacks by forcing every identity to prove itself to strangers. Each agent gets K=5 auditors drawn at random from outside its own grove of contacts, each checking one real proof. A violet flag marks any identity failing two audits, and its bond is slashed. One fake costs 10 POA in bond, so 1000 fakes cost 10000 POA locked, while an honest agent locks only 10 POA once. Auditors are paid from slashed bonds, and the tide of fakes cannot survive fresh auditors each epoch.
